title: Streak Start and End
scenario: Find the start_id and end_id for all streaks of consecutive numbers of length 3 or more. Return 'num', 'start_id', 'end_id'.
hint: Identify islands and filter by MIN/MAX ID.
correctQuery: SELECT num, MIN(id) AS start_id, MAX(id) AS end_id FROM (SELECT id, num, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY num ORDER BY id)::INT AS grp FROM logs) t GROUP BY num, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (3, '1'), (4, '1');
